name: ai-dotfiles
description: Personal AI tooling: planning-first workflow, a story-by-story Strict TDD loop, and an engineering toolkit on top of engram memory

plugins.name: flow
plugins.description: Planning-first workflow: research, scope + UX planning, review, gap filling, a backlog of one-line vertical stories, just-in-time story refinement with a size/risk line, Strict TDD pair programming (/flow:pair) that commits each test before its code, a read-only verifier for high-risk stories, and handoff to implementation.

plugins.name: toolkit
plugins.description: Engineering skills: Judgment Day dual review, work-unit commits, chained PRs, comment writing, doc design, skill authoring, Go testing.

plugins.name: look
plugins.description: A band above the prompt for background shells, agents, CI and backup alerts; draws nothing while idle.
